name: Binding And Loosing
overview: The biblical concept of 'Binding and Loosing' reflects the authority given by Christ to His followers to make spiritual decisions with heavenly affirmation, as seen in Matthew 16:19 and 18:18 where Jesus promises that whatever is bound or loosed on earth will be bound or loosed in heaven. This authority involves discerning and addressing sin within the community, exemplified by the instruction to confront a brother who sins in Matthew 18:15. The imagery of binding also conveys restraint and control, such as binding mercy and truth close to the heart (Proverbs 3:3) or binding a strong man to gain victory (Matthew 12:29), underscoring the power and responsibility entrusted to believers under Christ's lordship.
